headline: Crypto Exchanges Posted a $328 Million Net Outflow as Bitcoin Held Near 83k
narrative: Crypto exchanges recorded a net outflow of $328 million over the past day, equal to 0.12 percent of reserves. That pipe is mild accumulation: coins moved off trading venues instead of onto them for sale. Bitcoin held near 83k, up 0.88 percent on the day, while bitcoin exchange reserves fell by 515 coins over seven days to 1,241,083.
author: jordan
